name: domain-has-owner
label: A domain has a Domain row and an owner
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020, Jeff 11-20 09:03): the domain has its Domain row, and the row names who owns it. A domain nobody owns has nobody to make it green.
checkSpec: SELECT ?problem WHERE { { FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:domains> { chorus:{domain} a chorus:Domain } } BIND("no Domain row" AS ?problem) } UNION { GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:domains> { chorus:{domain} a chorus:Domain FILTER NOT EXISTS { chorus:{domain} chorus:ownedBy ?o } } BIND("no owner" AS ?problem) } }

name: domain-one-store
label: A domain keeps its rows in one store
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020; Jeff 11-20 09:01, one and only one source of a type of data). Narrowed: the Domain row names exactly one instancesGraph, and at most one store.kind Property.
checkSpec: SELECT ?problem WHERE { { SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?ig) AS ?n) WHERE { OPTIONAL { GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:domains> { chorus:{domain} chorus:instancesGraph ?ig } } } } FILTER(?n != 1) BIND(CONCAT(STR(?n), " instancesGraph values") AS ?problem) }

name: domain-one-door
label: A domain is served by its own generated API door
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020; #4995 athena-gen doors). Narrowed: the Domain row carries a server.bind Property, the setting its generated API is served from (athena-make stops mounting a domain that has one, #5017).
checkSpec: SELECT ?problem WHERE { FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:domains> { chorus:{domain} chorus:hasProperty ?b } GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:properties> { ?b chorus:propertyKey "server.bind" } } BIND("no generated API door (no server.bind Property)" AS ?problem) }

name: domain-no-side-door
label: No code reads or writes a domain's rows past its door
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020; DEC-093, ADR-048). Narrowed: code outside the domain's own unit (*/domains/<name>/) naming the domain's store graph, urn:chorus:domains:<name>. Tests, fixtures, the model and prose do not count.

name: domain-has-tests
label: A domain has tests
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020). Narrowed: at least one tracked test file carries @domain: <name> (#4334's header).

name: domain-referential-integrity
label: Every link from a domain's rows reaches a row
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020). Every chorus IRI a row in the domain's graph links to (rdf:type aside) is the subject of a row somewhere in the store. Runs on its own; it waits on neither #4049 nor #5019 (Borg Queen, 11-20).
checkSpec: SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { GRAPH <urn:chorus:domains:{domain}> { ?s ?p ?o FILTER(isIRI(?o) && STRSTARTS(STR(?o), STR(chorus:)) && ?p != rdf:type) } FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH ?any { ?o ?pp ?oo } } }

name: domain-shacl-conforms
label: A domain's rows conform to their shapes
comment: Complete-domain rule (#5020 AC5): the domain's rows and its Domain row, validated by Jena's SHACL against the live shapes, with the types of the rows they link to. Each validation result is a violation, so the shape and the policy push the same domain to green.
